guidebook.intro: Laga ekitiibwa mu Lungereza: okulamusa abakade, ebigambo eby’ekisa, n’okusembeza abagenyi.

tips.title: Okulamusa abakade
body: Aboogera Olungereza tebafukamira. Ekitiibwa kiri mu bigambo: **Good morning, sir. Good afternoon, madam.** Ku banafe abatamanyidwa: **Mr Mukasa**, **Mrs Nalwoga**, **Ms Nakato**.

tips.title: “You” y’emu
body: Mu Lusoga tukozesa obungi okulaga ekitiibwa: **mwasuze**, **mwebale**. Mu Lungereza **you** y’emu eri buli muntu. Ekitiibwa kiva mu **please**, **thank you** ne **would you**: **Would you like some tea?**

tips.title: Okusembeza omugenyi
body: **Come in! Please sit down. Make yourself at home.** Okuwa emere: **Please have some food.** Omugenyi adamu: **Thank you for having me.**

culture.title: Omugenyi asooka
body: Mu Uganda omugenyi aweebwa ekifo ekisinga n’emere esooka. Ku bagenyi aboogera Olungereza, nyonyola: **In Uganda the guest always comes first.**
